simple.meaning: a word ; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing ; adverbially, a cause
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּבָר (H1697) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 1455 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דָּבָר (dâbâr) means a word ; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing ; adverbially, a cause First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 22.

definitions.short: a word ; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing ; adverbially, a cause

definitions.full: H1697. dabar דָּבָר 1439 noun masculine speech, word — Gen 18:14 446t.; construct דְּבַר 12:17 361t.; suffix דְּבָרִי Num 11:23 + (suffixes 66 t.); singular in all 875 t.; plural דְּבָרִים Exod 4:10 182t.; construct דִּבְרֵי Gen 24:30 253t.; suffix דְּבָרָיו 37:8 (suffixes 127 t.); plural in all 564 t.; — I. singular speech, discourse, saying, word , as the sum of that which is spoken: 1 of men , a. דָּבָר נְבוֺן discreet in speech 1Sam 16:18 ; ׳ד שְׂפָתַיִם speech of lips Psa 59:13 , mere talk Isa 36:5 (= 2Kin 18:20 ) Prov 14:23 (compare Psa 17:4 speech of God's lips); מָר דָּבָר bitter speech 64:4 ; ׳ד כָּזָב lying speech Prov 30:8 ; טוֺכ דְּבָֽרְךָ thy saying is good 1Sam 9:10 ; עִם הָיָה אַבְנֵר וּדְבַר and the speech of Abner had been with the elders of Israel 2Sam 3:17 (compare 1Kin 1:7 ); הזה הדבר אמר say this saying Jer 23:38 ; 31:23 ; compare 13:12 ; 14:17 (of God), 1Sam 8:10 ( י ׳דִּבְרֵי ). b. word of command , ׳ד (הַ)מֶּלֶךְ 1Chr 21:4 , 6 ; Est 1:12 6 t. Esther; Eccl 8:4 compare 2Chr 30:5 ; 31:5 ; Dan 9:23 , 25 ; ׳ד מַלְכוּת royal edict Est 1:19 ; עשׂה כדבר do according to the command of Gen 44:2 ; 47:30 ; Exod 8:9 ; 8:27 ; 12:35 ; 32:28 (J) Lev 10:7 (P) Judg 11:10 ; Ezra 10:5 ; Neh 5:12-13 , compare 2Sam 17:6 (word of counsel), 1Kin 3:12 (request), 17:13 (proposal; on these meanings see below) c. message, report, tidings , הַזֶּה הָרָע אֶתהַֿדָּבָר הָעָם וַיִּשְׁמַע and the people heard this evil report Exod 33:4 (JE) compare 1Kin 20:12 ; הדבר (היה) אמת the report was true 10:6 2Chr 9:5 ; מֵעִמָּכֶם דָבָר בּוֺא עַד until word come from you 2Sam 15:28 ; נינוה מלך אל הדבר ויגע Jonah 3:6 ; דָּבָר הֵשִׁיב return or bring word, report Gen 37:14 ; Num 13:26 ; 22:8 (J) Deut 1:22 , 25 ; Josh 14:7 ; 22:32 (D) 1Kin 2:30 ; 20:9 ; 2Kin 22:9 , 20 (= 2Chr 34:16 , 28 ), but answer 1Sam 17:30 ; 2Sam 3:11 ; 24:13 (= 1Chr 21:12 ), 1Kin 12:6 , 9 (= 2Chr 10:6 , 9 ), 12:16 ; Neh 2:20 ; Prov 18:13 ; 27:11 ; Isa 41:28 ; Ezek 9:11 (Dr Sm, p, 190 explains the phrase as turn back with a word ); compare ענה (לא) דבר answer something or nothing 1Kin 18:21 ; 2Kin 18:36 ; Psa 119:42 ; Isa 36:21 ; Jer 44:20 see IV. 6 ; השׁיב דברים return words Exod 19:8 (E) Prov 24:26 see III. 1. d. advice, counsel , בלעם בדבר by advice of Balaam Num 31:16 (P), compare Judg 20:7 ; 2 Samuel 19:44; Est 5:5 . e. request , אמתו of his maid , עבדו of his servant 2Sam 14:15 , 22 . f. promise , דברו יחל לא he shall not break his word Num 30:3 (P), compare דבר הקים perform a promise Neh 5:13 , see also 2b. g. charge, complaint , הזה הדבר היה אמת אם if this charge be true Deut 22:20 ; compare 13:15 ; 17:4 , בְּ דבר שׂים 1Sam 22:15 , לְ דברים עלילות שׂים Deut 22:14 , 17 . h. decision, sentence , הַמִּשְׁמָּט דְּבַר the sentence of judgment Deut 17:9 compare 17:10 ; 17:11 . i. theme, story , טוֺב דָּבָר לִבִּי רָחַשׁ my heart swells with a good theme Psa 45:2 ; דְּבַרגְּבוּרוֺת the story of his great might Job 41:4 . 2 word of God , as a divine communication in the form of commandments, prophecy, and words of help to his people, used 394 times. This word is communicated in several ways: a. י דבר ׳ויהי אל then the word of Yahweh came unto 1Sam 15:10 ; 2Sam 7:4 (compare אלהים 1Chr 17:3 ), 1Kin 6:11 ; 13:20 ; 16:1 ; 17:2 , 8 ; 21:17 , 28 ; 2Chr 11:2 (compare האלהים 1Kin 12:22 ): compare 1Chr 22:8 ( על by confusion), Isa 38:4 ; Jer 1:4 20t. Jeremiah, Ezek 3:16 41t. Ezekiel; Jonah 1:1 ; 3:1 ; Hag 2:20 ; Zech 4:8 ; 6:9 ; 7:4 , 8 ; 8:1 (without אל ) 8:18 ; ד ׳היה ׳י אל Gen 15:1 ; 2Chr 12:7 ; Jer 25:3-4 t. Jeremiah; Ezek 1:3 7 t. Ezekiel; Dan 9:2 ; Zech 1:1 , 7 ; 7:1 ; ד ׳הנה ׳י אל Gen 15:4 ; 1Kin 19:9 ; ׳ד ׳י אל היה 2Sam 24:11 ; 1Kin 16:7 ; 18:1 ; 2Kin 20:4 ; Ezek 24:20 ; ד ׳היה ׳י ביד Hag 1:1 ; 2:1 , 10 ; ד ׳ויהי ׳י ביד 1:3 ; ד אל ׳היה ׳י אשׁר Hosea 1:1 ; Joel 1:1 ; Micah; Zeph 1:1 ; ד היה אשׁר ׳אליו ׳י 1Kin 18:31 ; Jer 1:2 ; ד היה ׳אשׁר ׳י יר ׳אל 14:1 ; 46:1 ; 47:1 ; 49:34 (see אשׁר 6a ); אל היה אשׁר הדבר 7:1 11 t. Jeremiah; ד ׳את ׳י 2Kin 3:12 ; Jer 23:28 ; 27:18 ; compare יְגֻנָּב דָּבָר אֵלַי unto me a word was brought by stealth Job 4:12 , compare י דְּבַר אֵלָיו יִגָּלֶה ׳וְטֶרֶם and the word of Yahweh was not yet revealed unto him 1Sam 3:7 . Yahweh also sends his word שׁלח Psa 107:20 ; 147:18 ; Isa 9:7 ; Jer 42:5 (compare plural Zech 7:12 ) and makes it an object of vision ראה Jer 2:31 ; 38:21 (compare plural Ezek 11:25 ), חזה Isa 2:1 ; it is also commanded צוה Exod 16:16 , 32 ; 35:4 ; Lev 8:5 ; 9:6 ; 17:2 ; Num 30:2 ; 36:6 (P) Deut 4:2 ; 13:1 ; 15:15 ; Josh 1:13 ; 4:10 (D) 1Chr 16:15 (= Psa 105:8 ) Neh 1:8 ; Jer 7:23 , compare צוה אשׁר הדברים Exod 35:1 ; Lev 8:36 (P) Exod 19:7 (E) Deut 6:6 . b. Yahweh confirms his word of promise Deut 9:5 ; 1Sam 1:23 (where read דְּבָרֵךְ thy word according to ᵑ6 ᵐ5 & Dr), 1Kin 2:4 ; 6:12 ; 8:20 ; Jer 29:10 ; 33:14 , and his word of warning 1Kin 12:15 ; Dan 9:12 ; his word stands for ever Isa 40:8 ; it is settled for ever in heaven Psa 119:89 ; he remembers his holy word קדשׁו דבר 105:42 (compare קָדְשׁוֺ דִּבְרֵי Jer 23:9 ); he himself Joel 2:11 , the angels Psa 103:20 , and forces of nature 148:8 דברו עשׂה do his word of command; by his word the heavens were made 33:6 ; it is near his people, in their mouth and heart Deut 30:14 ; a lamp to their feet Psa 119:105 . II. saying, utterance, sentence , as a section of a discourse: — 1 of men , a. בְּעִתּוֺ דָּבָר a word in due season Prov 15:23 compare Job 4:2 ; Prov 12:25 ; commonly in plural, (הַ)שִּׁירָ(הׅ דִּבְרֵי words of the song (i.e. its lines of poetry) Deut 31:30 ; 32:44 ; Psa 18:1 (= 2Sam 22:1 ) Psa 137:3 ; דויד בדברי הלל to sing praises with the words of David (his psalms) 2Chr 29:30 ; חֲכָמִים דִּבְרֵי sentences of the wise Prov 1:6 ; 22:17 ; Eccl 9:17 ; 12:11 ; these sayings are commonly written , compare האגרת דברי words of the letter Est 9:26 ; עתיקים הדברים the records are ancient 1Chr 4:22 ; (ה)סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי Isa 29:11 , 18 ; Jer 29:1 . b. title of writings: קֹהֶלֶת דִּבְרֵי Eccl 1:1 , ׳ד אגור Prov 30:1 , ׳ד למואל 31:1 , ׳ד ירמיהו Jer 1:1 , so Amos 1:1 ; Neh 1:1 ; compare in appended phrase or clause, Jer 51:64 , ׳ד איוב Job 31:40 . c. in Chronicles name of a work: ׳ד החזים 2Chr 33:18-19 , ׳בד שׁמעיה 12:15 , ׳בד יהוא 20:34 , ד על ׳שׁמואל 1Chr 29:29 ; ד ׳על נתן 29:29 ; 2Chr 9:29 , ׳ד על גד 1Chr 29:29 . (It is not certain whether writings of prophets or histories about them are referred to; in the latter case they are acts , IV. 2 , see Dr Intr 497 .) 2 of God: הַדְּבָרִים עֲשֶׂרֶת the ten words (sentences in the tables) Exod 34:28 (JE) Deut 4:13 ; 10:4 , referred to as הדברים Exod 34:1 (JE) Deut 4:10 , 36 ; 5:19 ; 9:10 ; 10:2 ; of commands of covenant code Exod 24:3-4 , 8 ; compare 34:27 (JE); of Deuteronomic code Deut 17:19 (+ 16 t. D) 2Kin 22:11 ; 23:3-24 (compare 2Chr 34:19-31 ) Jer 11:2-8 ; 34:18 ; the law-book of Joshua Josh 24:26 (E); of the code of Ezra Ezra 7:11 ; 9:4 ; Neh 8:9 , 13 ; the words of Yahweh written by Jeremiah Jer 25:13 ; 36:4-32 ; 51:61 ; the words of the book of Daniel Dan 12:4 , 9 ; commands in General 1Sam 15:11 ; Psa 50:17 ; 119:57 ; 119:130 ; 119:139 ; promises 2Sam 7:28 ; Neh 9:8 , compare 1Chr 25:5 ; 2Chr 36:16 . III. a word, words: — 1 of men: אֲחָדִים וּדְבָרִים אֶחָ֑ת שָׂפָה one lip, and one and the same words Gen 11:1 (J); דְּבָרִים וְאֵין אֹמֶר אֵין no speech and no words Psa 19:4 ; דְּבָרִים אִישׁ man of words , ready in speech, Exod 4:10 (J); דברים רב multitude of words Job 11:2 ; Prov 10:19 ; Eccl 5:2 ; דְּבָרִים עִמָּכֶם קְחוּ take with you words Hosea 14:3 ; (ה)שׁקר דבר(י) lying word(s) Exod 5:9 ; 23:7 (E) Prov 13:5 ; 29:12 ; Isa 59:13 ; Jer 7:4 , 8 ; רוּחַ דִּבְרֵי words of wind , vain words Job 16:3 ; נִשְׁמַעבּֿוֺ דָּבָר וּמַהשֶּֿׁמֶץ and what a whisper of a word we hear of him! 26:14 . 2 of God. It is difficult to determine how many of the following should come under II. 2. The plural for words of God is relatively seldom: Gen 20:8 ; Exod 19:6 ; Num 12:6 ; Josh 3:9 (E) Exod 4:28 , 30 ; Num 11:24 (J) Deut 18:19 ; Josh 23:14 (D) 1Sam 3:18 ; 8:10 ; 15:1 ; 2Chr 11:4 ; Job 42:7 ; Prov 30:6 ; Isa 31:2 ; Dan 10:11 ; Amos 8:11 ; Micah 2:7 ; apart from Jer 3:12 30t. Jeremiah; Ezek 2:7 4 t. Ezekiel; Zech 1:6 4 t. Zechariah. IV. matter, affair , thing about which one speaks: — 1 business, occupation: הַמֶּלֶךְ דְּבַר king's business 1Sam 21:9 ; לְכָלדְּֿבַר for every matter of 1Chr 26:32 ; 27:1 ; 2Chr 19:11 ; לְכָלֿ דְּבָרֶיךָ for all thine affairs 1Chr 28:21 ; המזבח דבר Num 18:7 ; עִם אֵיןלָֿהֶם דָּבָר they had not dealings with Judg 18:7 , 28 ; בְּיוֺמוֺ דְּבַריֿוֺם the task or portion of a day in its day, daily duty or due Exod 5:13 , 19 (E) 16:4 (J) Lev 23:37 (P) 1Kin 8:59 ; 2Kin 25:30 ; 1Chr 16:37 ; 2Chr 8:13 ( ביום ) 8:14 ; 31:16 ; Ezra 3:4 ; Neh 11:23 ; 12:47 ; Jer 52:34 ; Dan 1:5 ; בשׁנה שׁנה דבר 1Kin 10:25 ; 2Chr 9:24 . 2 plural acts construct דִּבְרֵי 1Kin 11:41 (twice in verse); 1Chr 29:29 ; 2Chr 12:15 ; 16:11 ; דְּבָרָיו his acts 13:22 ; 35:27 ; especially in phrases, דִּבְרֵי עַלסֵֿפֶר ֗֗֗ דִּבְרֵי וְיֶתֶר הַיָּמִים and the rest of the acts of . . . in the book of the chronicles ( daily record of events ) of 1Kin 14:29 32t. Kings; דִּבְרֵי וְיֶתֶר 2Chr 13:22 8 t. Chronicles, דְּבָרָיו וְיֶתֶר 28:26 , דִּבְרֵי שְׁאָר 9:29 are referred to various sources; compare also הימים דברי במספר 1Chr 27:24 , דויד בדברי 23:27 , ישׂראל מלכי עלדֿברי 2Chr 33:18 : טובים דברים good deeds 12:12 ; 19:13; עֲוֺנֹת דִּבְרֵי acts of iniquity Psa 65:4 (De, Fälle von Missethaten ); דִּבְרֵירָֿע evil deeds Jer 5:28 . It is used of God, only in יענה לא דבריו כל Job 33:13 , ׳ד אֹתוֺתָיו Psa 105:27 , ׳ד נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ 145:5 . 3 matter, affair: אוריה דבר affair of Uriah 1Kin 15:5 ; דבר שׁרשׁ root of the matter Job 19:28 ; הדבר היה מה how went the matter ? 1Sam 4:16 ; 2Sam 1:4 compare Ruth 3:18 ; הדבר פני את סבב change the face of the matter 2Sam 14:20 ; הָאֲתֹנוֺת דִּבְרֵי the matter of the asses 1Sam 10:2 ; הרצח דבר זה this is the case of the slayer Deut 19:4 ; לְכָלדְּֿבָרָיו 1Kin 6:38 as to all its particulars. 4 events, things: in the phrase, האלה הדברים אחר after these things (events in time) Gen 15:1 ; 22:1 ; 40:1 (E) 39:7 (J) 1Kin 17:17 ; 21:1 ; Ezra 7:1 ; 22:8 ; דברים בעל one having a case 24:14 , compare משׁפט בדבר 2Chr 19:6 ; וּנְכֹחִים טוֺבִים דְּבָרֶיךָ pleas, good and right 2Sam 15:3 compare Josh 20:4 . 6 something, anything (indefinite): דבר עשׂה do a thing Gen 22:16 + (frequent);
